Actual Leia Seeker entry from [[:File:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]], PDF page 82, rectangle (176,356,512,404) points, 2 pixels/point. This published document records “present with” / “choose one to be lost,” unlike the actual first physical card. The official archive GIF matches this document. No reconstructed face or executable identifier is invented. [[Category:Card images]]
